articles.title: Omnicom's Transformation Consultancy Strengthens Capabilities with the Launch of Unified Adobe Practice
articles.mainIdea: Omnicom's Transformation Consultancy Strengthens Capabilities with the Launch of Unified Adobe Practice
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Omnicom's Transformation Consultancy Strengthens Capabilities with the Launch of Unified Adobe Practice. Omnicom (NYSE: OMC), the world's leading marketing and sales company, today announced that Credera, its transformation consultancy, has launched a comprehensive Adobe practice designed to meet the evolving needs of enterprise organizations. Nik DeBenedetto, former CEO of LeapPoint, which Omnicom acquired in 2024, will lead the Adobe practice as Global Managing Director. As part of this launch, LeapPoint will be fully integrated into Credera. Related tickers mentioned: OMC.
